note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Sales wants to cut the price of our premium coffee machine from $800 to $720 to win volume. It costs us $520 to make.

answers.common.decision: Whether to approve the price cut; the commercial director decides.
answers.common.deadline: The pricing committee meets next week.
answers.common.audience: The commercial director and the sales lead.
answers.common.materials: We sell 2,000 units a month at the current price. Sales expects the lower price to lift volume to 2,400 units a month.
answers.finance-modeling.purpose: Show what the price cut does to monthly gross margin.
answers.finance-modeling.data: Monthly unit sales, list price and unit cost for the machine, in US dollars.
